old_problem: The M.2 write-heavy objective contradicts a read-only job and lacks an authorized namespace, extent, runtime and pass criteria.
disposition_reason: ED-04 cannot silently introduce 70% destructive writes where the literal job issues none. This would materially change endurance risk and coverage, so source-owner authorization and M.2-specific limits are mandatory.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row8 all18 XLSX cells and history2624.
Preserved 70%-write M.2 identity and the literal zero-write conflict.
No fio or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: M.2 FIO QD1 512B 70% write validation pending semantic authority
test_case.purpose: Measure the approved write-heavy M.2 mixed-random profile with separately judged read/write performance.
required_package: Approval for randrw+rwmixread=30 instead of randread
Pinned fio/version and reviewed job digest
Disposable non-OS namespace with serial/controller/BDF, extent and access mode
Authorized duration and write-heavy performance/latency limits
Data-loss authorization, endurance/SMART/thermal/power aborts and owner recovery
test_case.test_command: Leave the contradictory source disabled. After approval, verify the exact namespace is disposable and excluded from OS/boot/mount/RAID/holders, record NVMe health, execute one bounded QD1 512B job at the approved 70%-write mix, retain fio JSON and telemetry, and leave namespace recreation to the owner.
test_case.expected_result: Only the authorized namespace receives the intended write-heavy mix, all limits pass, and NVMe/platform health remains acceptable.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires authoritative 70%-write semantics and numeric limits. Read-only output cannot count as this coverage.
safety_gate: Block writes until workload and data-loss authority exist.
Map serial/controller/BDF and reject protected or active namespaces.
Pin size/runtime and verify remaining endurance/health before launch.
Abort on critical warning, media/thermal/power error; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Pre/post NVMe health/endurance plus kernel logs
test_case.recovery: If write endurance, media health or target mapping deviates, stop the write-heavy process, preserve percentage/health/error evidence, keep the namespace offline, and require storage-owner impact review before format or reuse.

source_conflict.reason: A 70%-write M.2 objective remains incompatible with read-only randread.

blocked.reason: Authorized semantics and runtime bindings can be provided.
